# Cortecho

Cortecho is the brain for a rooted Amazon Echo Dot. It speaks the ESPHome
native API to echo-dot-assist (hassmic), turns speech into text, runs an agent
with tools, and speaks the answer back. No Home Assistant needed. This project
is not affiliated with Amazon; Amazon, Echo and Alexa are trademarks of
Amazon.com, Inc.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): what it is, why an Echo Dot, quick start, FAQ.
- [Protocol](docs/protocol.md): how a turn works, ESPHome messages, follow-ups.
- [Performance](docs/performance.md): where the answer latency goes.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): the three layers, every setting.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): Docker, ports, backups.
- [Echo setup](docs/echo-setup.md): echo-dot-assist, API key, clock, wake word.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptom and fix.
- [Development](docs/development.md): commands, tests, adding a tool.
- [HTTP API](docs/http-api.md): endpoints and error shape.
- [Set up with an agent](docs/setup-with-an-agent.md): a page for a coding agent.
